413-803-6871-6879.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact creature in hand with the mana to cast it.
413-803-6871-6879.description:
Cast any artifact creature by paying its mana cost.
When the artifact creature enters as an Ally due to Arcane Adaptation, Haru and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Haru trigger, earthbending the artifact creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat steps 2 through 4 once.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 5, causing a player to mill three cards.
Repeat from step 5.

147-653-5256.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
147-653-5256.description:
Cast Fearsome Awakening by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Fearsome Awakening.
Holding priority, activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage, causing a player to mill card(s).
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Fearsome Awakening
Resolve the Fearsome Awakening copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

Remove a -1/-1 counter and a +1/+1 counter from that creature as a state-based action.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat

When Wispweaver Angel enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.

2511-3644-6972.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Young Wolf

Young Wolf enters and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness. Its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability from step 4.
Repeat from step 4.

2112-4050-6972.notes: If Hound of Griselbrand starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 3 instead.

Repeat from step 2.

Activate Eternal Scourge's scavenge ability, granted to it by Young Deathclaws, by paying {3} and exiling Eternal Scourge from your graveyard, putting six +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler due to Loading Zone.
Activate Crystalline Crawler six times by removing six +1/+1 counters from it, adding {6}.
Cast Eternal Scourge from exile by paying {3}.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Eternal Scourge.
Repeat.

Teval triggers, creating two creature tokens.

Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat from step 3.

When Traveling Plague enters, Archon of Sun's Grace triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat from step 3.

Resolve the Changeling Berserker trigger, exiling Bladewing until Changeling Berserker leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Warstorm Surge trigger, dealing damage to Changeling Berserker equal to Changeling Berserker's power.
Changeling Berserker dies as a state-based action due to having 0 or less toughness.
When Changeling Berserker dies, it triggers, returning Bladewing from exile to the battlefield.
When Bladewing enters the battlefield, it and Warstorm Surge trigger.
Resolve the Warstorm Surge trigger, dealing damage equal to Bladewing's power to any target.
Resolve the Bladewing trigger, returning Changeling Berserker from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

Activate Marvin using Morphling's ability by paying {U}, untapping it.

Resolve the Whitemane Lion trigger, returning it to your hand from the battlefield.
Activate Farrelite Priest by paying {1}, adding {W}.

If you control at least two Cats outside of Whitemane Lion, this combo nets infinite mana.

Resolve the Undercity Informer ability, causing you to put Narcomoeba into your graveyard from the top of your library.
Narcomoeba triggers, returning itself to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

Activate Samwise by sacrificing Gingerbrute and the two Foods, returning Vegetation Abomination to your hand from the battlefield.
Cast Vegetation Abomination by paying {2}{G}.
When Vegetation Abomination enters the battlefield, Samwise triggers, creating two Food tokens.
Activate the two Food tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Samwise by sacrificing Vegetation Abomination and the two Foods, returning Gingerbrute to your hand from the battlefield.
Repeat.

Resolve Out of Time's trigger, untapping all creatures then failing to phase them out since Out of Time has left the battlefield.
